name: Amit the Paperman
summary:
BE BOUNDLESS AND TEAR THROUGH ALL LIMITS!

Its a average day on the paper planet of Papercury until the president Porker P Prez decided that his planet needed less organic life and more machines! Its a bad situation for everyone especially a humble janitor called Amit! A ton of President Porker's men ransacked him! But he won't take this sitting down! Speed through environments, smash through foes, and use the power of the Pristine Pencils to transform into all shapes and sizes! Be bold and be boundless in AMIT THE PAPER MAN!
